extracted.name: Steamed Plum Pudding
extracted.description: This steamed plum pudding made with dates, raisins, currants, and candied fruit peel is perfect for Christmas. Delicious served warm with ice cream.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cup candied mixed fruit peel, chopped
instruction_lines: In a large saucepan combine butter, sugar, milk, dates, raisins, currants, mixed fruit peel and zest of the orange; bring to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in baking soda. Sift in the flour, cinnamon and salt; mix gently until blended. Pour into prepared pudding mold.
Cover with a double layer of greased wax paper and steam for 2 hours.
